jcr:content.jcr:title: Translation Project Due
jcr:content.jcr:description: Started by Translation Projects for a project with a due date: an Inbox item for the project's owner, due on that date. It ends by itself when every job of the project is complete or the project is deleted; completing it dismisses the reminder.

dynamic_participant.jcr:title: Translation project due
dynamic_participant.jcr:description: The translation project is due: open it (Translation → Translation Projects), finish its jobs, then complete this item.
